questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The best-paid jobs in the UK and how to get them
How to become a professional wedding photographer
People who do a second job using skills or passions
Why young people don't want to work long hours
questions.why: Neil and Rob discuss side hustles, second jobs that use your skills and interests.

questions.q: What would Rob do as a second job if he had time?
options: Take photos and sell them
Teach English online
Make and sell rag rugs
Write software for apps
questions.why: He says he'd take photographs and sell them because he loves photography.

questions.q: According to Henley Business School research, how many workers run a side hustle?
options: About one in ten
About half
About one in four
About three in four
questions.why: The research says around one in four workers run at least one side hustle.

questions.q: Which age group is most likely to have a side hustle?
options: Over 50
questions.why: Neil says those aged 25 to 34 are most likely, with 37% running a sideline.

questions.q: What risk did Elspeth Jackson take when her side hustle became her main job?
options: She had to move abroad to find customers
She lost the security of a regular wage
She had to borrow a lot of money from the bank
She had to work nights as well as days
questions.why: She talks about leaving a very regular wage and the security it gives.

questions.q: Why doesn't Elspeth want to go back to a big company?
options: She would lose the flexibility she's used to
The pay is too low for the hours you work
She didn't get on with her old colleagues
Big companies won't hire her at her age
questions.why: She says she'd be sacrificing the flexibility she's become accustomed to.

questions.q: What does Becci Mae Ford like about working for the telecoms company?
options: It pays very well and has a pension
It gives her lots of holiday every year
It is creative work, like her crafts
It gets her out of the house to meet people
questions.why: She says it gets her out the house and meeting people in a social environment.

questions.q: How does Becci Mae Ford feel about having two jobs?
options: It's easy and relaxing, and she has lots of free time
It gives her balance but is harder than people think
She wants to give up her crafting company next year
It is boring all the time, and she wants a change
questions.why: She says it gives creative balance but 'It's definitely a grind.'
